headline: Last session: Sensex surpassed 81,000 and Nifty crossed 25,000; markets closed today for Diwali-Balipratipada

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 11 November.

why: NSE and BSE are closed today, Tuesday 10 November 2026, on account of Diwali-Balipratipada.
In the last trading session, Indian equities extended gains to hit their highest levels in over eight months.
Banking and pharmaceutical stocks led the market rally in the previous session.
Modest market gains were supported by a correction in crude oil prices.
whatHappening: Indian stock exchanges are shut today for a public holiday and trading will resume on Wednesday, 11 November.
In the previous trading day, Sensex ended 107 points higher above 81,000 while Nifty settled above 25,000.
Data Patterns shares jumped 9% during the last trading session.
Asian stocks rallied globally following a rebound in US tech shares and falling oil prices.
summary: Indian stock markets are closed today, Tuesday 10 November 2026, for Diwali-Balipratipada and will reopen on Wednesday. On the last trading day, Sensex closed above 81,000 and Nifty held above 25,000, led by gains in banking and pharma stocks. Data Patterns rallied 9% in the previous session.
